core_meaning.primary_meaning: Anwaar is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Light”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Anwaar corresponds to the Arabic form أنوار (Arabic root ن و ر (n-w-r); أَنْوَار (ʾanwār)). Its core sense is light. Anwaar is Arabic أَنْوَار (ʾanwār) 'Light', the broken plural of نُور (nūr, 'light') from the root ن و ر (n-w-r).
